correctness.rationale: Every 3-edge-coloring of a cubic graph is a partition into three pairwise disjoint perfect matchings. Recursive lowest-unmatched-vertex enumeration is exhaustive and gives exactly 42 perfect matchings; complementary disjoint pairs give precisely 20 globally color-normalized factorizations. Each pair of colors forms an even 2-factor, whose connected cycles exhaust all valid Kempe switches. A wholly fresh DP matching-and-switch enumeration reconstructed all 20 canonical 27-coordinate colorings, the 36 undirected adjacency edges and the deterministic complete-graph SHA-256 56ffa0b44d5b539ae41cc4056f5b6ca8821b12eaae1cad70608a02a36680ada6; degree histogram 2*9+18*3, two components of size 10, deletion of each unique degree-9 apex leaves three disjoint triangles, and all 20 cycle signatures matched. This is a complete finite proof for the single specified labeled graph, not a sampling extrapolation.
residual_risks: No assertion for other cubic graphs, all-named-coloring graph, or quotient by graph automorphisms.

value.rationale: The Pappus graph is a canonical highly symmetric 18-vertex cubic bipartite graph, and Kempe switch connectivity is an established nontrivial reconfiguration invariant. Its exact quotient graph has unexpected rigid local geometry: two disconnected ten-vertex windmills with one highly mobile center in each and a simple intrinsic bichromatic-cycle characterization. The complete adjacency is independently reusable for Kempe-dynamics research and much sharper than merely counting components.
residual_risks: Theorem is deliberately one finite graph; a new general theory is not claimed or required.

final_claim: For the given 18-vertex labeled Pappus cubic graph with LCF shifts (5,7,-7,7,-7,-5)^3, the graph of proper 3-edge-colorings modulo GLOBAL color permutations, with single whole-bichromatic-cycle Kempe exchanges, is isomorphic to 2 copies of K_1 join (3 K_3). Exactly 20 colorings, 36 edges, two ten-configuration components and specified (6,6,6) vs (18) two-factor signatures; graph automorphisms are not quotiented.
limitations: Color names are quotient only; graph-vertex labels retained.
Only given Pappus graph; published connected-component counts are acknowledged.
